purpose.zh: 双腿举起时练主动开腿的力量
purpose.en: Build active leg-opening strength with the legs lifted.

text.zh: 双腿伸直，对抗弹力带分成大V字
text.en: Keep your legs straight and open them into a wide V against the band

text.zh: 仰卧，双腿举起与地面垂直，腰贴地
text.en: Lie on your back with your legs up vertical and your lower back down.

text.zh: 开到最大停2秒，再慢慢合拢
text.en: Pause for two seconds at the widest point, then close slowly.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the lower back off the floor.

cautions.zh: 髋部疼痛时减小开腿幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Open less if your hips hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
